name: Worms (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Worms (a white key and a yellow star on red).
history: Municipal flag of Worms; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Worms arms — key and star on red
